title: The Doorway Stall at the Worst Moment | Parenting Rewind
description:
Just as you open the door, your child remembers one more toy, drink, and story. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: Just as you open the door, your child remembers one more toy, drink, and story. Answering every new request can accidentally turn delay into a successful strategy. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Name the plan once: We are leaving now; choose one small toy before I count to ten, or we leave without one. Make the transition clear, keep the consequence related, and reconnect once everyone is moving.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Tips for Using Consequences

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
